# Reachable govulncheck findings that are accepted, each with the reason above
# it. The govulncheck workflow fails on any reachable finding that is not listed
# here. An entry holds while the vulnerability database knows no fixed version;
# to accept a finding whose fix cannot be applied yet, put the last day of the
# acceptance after the ID (GO-2026-0000 2027-01-31). Remove an entry when the
# workflow warns that it is no longer reported.

# nuts-node advisory GHSA-9hmg-827w-9rhj. The Go vulnerability database lists no
# fixed version for this module path, but the pinned nuts-node commit (22ceb753)
# already contains the fix (41eecd456c90). Goes away when the knooppunt moves to
# github.com/nuts-foundation/nuts-node/v6.
GO-2026-5291

# Fixed in echo v4.16.3 (GHSA-246p-cpwv-v3jq), but the Go vulnerability database
# lists no fixed version for echo/v4, so govulncheck reports every v4 release.
# It does not apply here either: the embedded nuts-node uses the echo rate
# limiter only for internal paths and does not identify callers by IP, so a
# spoofed X-Forwarded-For changes nothing.
GO-2026-6872

# Fixed in echo v4.16.3 (GHSA-99jh-6h7p-pp36), but the Go vulnerability database
# lists no fixed version for echo/v4, so govulncheck reports every v4 release.
# It does not apply here either: it concerns the echo reverse proxy middleware,
# which neither the knooppunt nor the embedded nuts-node uses.
GO-2026-6875
